$comment: UOB's published page on adding its cards to mobile wallets with Digital Token authentication (Decisions 5 and 7). A published page, not contract terms. One clause per overview paragraph, per part, and per FAQ question with its answer; the page's navigation, its second copy of the setup part, the FAQ group headings and the cookie notice are left out. Each capture whose text differs is a version; effective_from is the capture date (the page shows no date of its own). The page's own start date ('From 1 July 2025') goes on the wallet_provisioning request row, not here. From the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine (capture 13 August 2026; fetched 24 November 2026).

document.title: Add your cards securely to mobile wallet with Digital Token

markers.at: ^\s*From 1 July 2025, authentication through SMS One-Time-Password \(OTP\) when you add your UOB Mastercard or Visa Card\(s\) to your mobile wallets \(for payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay and Samsung Pay\) will be progressively changed to Digital Token Authentication via the UOB TMRW app to protect you against potential scams\.\s*$
^\s*The adding of UOB American Express and UnionPay Card\(s\) to mobile wallets is currently not supported\.\s*$

^\s*Please note that SMS OTP authentication will no longer be available\. Customers without digital access or digital token will be notified to set up their digital access and digital token before proceeding with mobile wallet provisioning\.\s*$
